title: Preview a text transformation
goal: Apply one anchored substitution while preserving and verifying the original.
challenge: Change only the label=old data line to label=new in the supplied home-directory config. Leave the comment and port unchanged. Preview, inspect a candidate diff, preserve a metadata backup, apply deliberately, verify, then restore exactly.

steps.explanation: Create a unique learner-owned guest workspace. Stop if creation or cd fails. Retain its printed path; variables do not survive disk Resume.
steps.expected: A fresh directory inside the guest home; no existing files are changed.

steps.command: printf '%s\n' '# label=old' 'port=8080' 'label=old' > original.conf; cp -p original.conf working.conf; sha256sum original.conf > original.sha256
steps.explanation: This is a guest-home sample, not /etc or a real service configuration.
Preview emits stdout and does not edit working.conf. Anchors avoid changing the comment.
steps.expected: Only the exact data line is transformed.

steps.command: sed 's/^label=old$/label=new/' working.conf > candidate.conf; diff -u original.conf candidate.conf
steps.explanation: A diff status of 1 means differences, not a read failure; inspect which differences.

steps.command: grep -Fx 'port=8080' candidate.conf; grep -Fx 'label=new' candidate.conf; cp -p working.conf before.conf; cp -p candidate.conf working.conf; cmp candidate.conf working.conf; sha256sum -c original.sha256
steps.explanation: Publish only after checking the small defined format. No general configuration validation is implied.

steps.command: cp -p before.conf working.conf; cmp original.conf working.conf; printf 'rollback=%s\n' "$?"
steps.explanation: Restore the preserved file and verify exact bytes. Keep the candidate as evidence.

hints: Why inspect a candidate before overwriting the working file?
Compare actual output, immediate exit status and resulting files. A syntactically valid command or script can still do the wrong thing.
Keep the original, verify a small intended change, and demonstrate rollback inside this workspace.
review: I retained the stated observations and can explain the outcome.
I checked failure cases and preserved originals; my review is not an application-verified score.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 partial 103.2 sed, 103.7 substitution. Reinforcement is labeled; no full-objective mastery. Completion records self-review, not verified assessment. No score.
